---
title: "embedpdf with one PDF in a native and a PDF.js embed"
resources:
  - "files/large.pdf"
---

Both embeds show `files/large.pdf`, the PDF of 14 pages and over 128 KB that
`large_test.qmd` also shows. The native embed comes first and the PDF.js
embed second. The checks in `tests/` serve this PDF from another site
(`--remote cors`), to check that the PDF.js embed loads it by byte ranges
while the native embed on the same page shows the same PDF.
